purpose: Same-origin Next.js proxy for authenticated checkout draft creation.
businessRules: The browser must not read or send the backend bearer token directly; this route forwards the HTTP-only customer session cookie as Authorization.
Proceed-to-checkout requires an Idempotency-Key because creating or reusing a checkout order ID is a customer mutation.
Unauthenticated customers receive 401 so the cart page can show the login-required dialog before entering checkout.
The proxy forwards only the cart product IDs and quantities; backend owns all pricing, media, SKU, category, and expiry logic.
All ShrestaApiError messages are passed through toShrestaUserMessage() — infrastructure codes become a generic string; 5xx responses return as 503.
401 responses additionally delete the session cookie so stale sessions are cleared client-side.
